messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High enqueue depth on inference-pool-3. 95th latency spiking to ~4s, error_rate=5% over 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Autoscaler at 90% and queuing growing.

jen_oncall: seeing it live. paging SRE. starting mitigation checklist.

miguel_sre: +1. Immediate suggested mitigations (short):
1) Apply org-level spike throttle (burst=50/s, steady=20/s)
2) Increase continuous batching window from 50ms -> 250ms to pack more requests (expected +20-40% throughput, p99 latency +~200ms)
3) Disable streaming for non-critical orgs to reduce token flush overhead
4) Temporarily reduce max_input_tokens for free-tier to 512
Any concerns?

aar oncall: how do we flip the batch window? need command/snippet.

miguel_sre: using admin-config API — sample:
```
curl -X POST 'https://internal-config.local/api/v1/batching/config' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"query":{"target":"inference-pool-3"},"patch":{"continuous_window_ms":250,"max_batch_tokens":4096}}'
```
Apply streaming toggle per-org:
```
curl -X POST 'https://internal-config.local/api/v1/featureflags' -d '{"org_pattern":"trial-*","feature":"streaming","enabled":false}'
```
(These are internal endpoints — will run via deploy-bot if someone from oncall triggers.)

jen_oncall: executing now (running via internal console).

deploy-bot: config update applied by jen_oncall at 2790001280: batching.continuous_window_ms=250; batching.max_batch_tokens=4096; streaming.disabled_for_pattern=trial-*

lina_pm: which customers are impacted by this change? any paying customers in SLOs affected?

ash_support: initial triage: mostly free-tier and trial orgs spamming long-context requests. One mid-market customer (org-omega) reported degraded latency and opened ticket #2345. CS already looped in. No enterprise SLO violations observed yet.

miguel_sre: expected customer impact: interactive workloads may see +150-400ms median added latency depending on client batching. Tradeoff: fewer tail errors and much reduced GPU queuing. Monitoring to watch: enqueue_depth, gpu_util, p99_latency, error_rate.

jen_oncall: handing overnight to miguel_sre. miguel, you take lead on monitoring + postmortem?

miguel_sre: I will. Immediate action items: collect traces, batch shape histograms, per-org request distribution. Drafting mitigation playbook: adaptive per-org batching thresholds and emergency org-level throttles.

jen_oncall: pinging @lina_pm and @ash_support to prepare customer comms explaining short-term latency tradeoff for stability. :white_check_mark:

ash_support: sent proactive note to affected trial orgs and to org-omega with suggested client workaround: set client flag prefer_low_latency=true to route to low-latency pool if they have it enabled. Logged ticket updates.

miguel_sre: added quick revert runbook:
```
# revert batching window to previous
curl -X POST 'https://internal-config.local/api/v1/batching/config' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":{"target":"inference-pool-3"},"patch":{"continuous_window_ms":50,"max_batch_tokens":2048}}'
# re-enable streaming
curl -X POST 'https://internal-config.local/api/v1/featureflags' -d '{"org_pattern":"trial-*","feature":"streaming","enabled":true}'
```

jen_oncall: monitoring update (10m after change): enqueue depth down ~65%, gpu_util smoother, error_rate down to 0.6%. p95 latency still elevated but stable. Closing active pager, miguel will own follow-up.

miguel_sre: will produce a short postmortem with batch-shape plots and recommend: 1) adaptive batching per-org, 2) per-model batching profiles, 3) emergency throttle automation.

jen_oncall: thanks all. :thumbsup:
